directory._note: Groups set ORDER ONLY - the directory renders as one continuous 3-across grid with no headings or dividing rules. The labels are kept here to document intent. Order is group order, then alphabetical inside each group; anyone whose role matches no group is appended last. bio_label {name} is the first name.

day_page._note: Rows show watch_label and link to the session's Squarespace Page from Airtable as soon as that field is filled, so links can be tested before launch. No field yet = soon_label, greyed and unclickable. Access during and after the event is controlled by setting the session page active/inactive in Squarespace; an inactive page redirects to the expired page with the upgrade offer. The per-day Coming Soon / Watch Now / Expired button below each day's list is maintained by hand in Squarespace and is deliberately not generated here.
